So we already knew it was possible to get an infinite loop with Apostate (I forget if that was resolved with the fireside chats) but someone on BGG pointed out a new loop with Infinitor!

 

Haka eats all of Infinitor's manifestations with Savage Mana.

Infinitor is on his front side and in advanced mode.

His end of turn text will play every card in his deck for ever.

If damage is reduced to all targets by 1 (say with a Biomemetic Plasma Vat) no one can ever die and the game locks up!

 

Anyone see any problems in the logic of this?

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
On-shots remain in play until their entire text has resolved (including the next played card)

 

So Infinitor plays a one-shot, which plays another one-shot, etc etc until every one-shot in is deck has been played.  Then he shuffles the trash and continues playing one-shots until the deck is empty again.  Then he reshuffles again.  But now the trash is empty so the deck stays empty, he can't do anything, and he fails to play a card.  Then all the one-shots resolve and are put in the trash.

 

No errata is needed.

posts.cooked: Haka Rampages with enough plus to damage to kill Relic Spirit, which brings back Runes of Malediction. Haka continues to Rampage, destroys the Runes, which brings back Relic Spirit. That gets destroyed which brings back the Runes, etc.
posts.raw: Haka Rampages with enough plus to damage to kill Relic Spirit, which brings back Runes of Malediction. Haka continues to Rampage, destroys the Runes, which brings back Relic Spirit. That gets destroyed which brings back the Runes, etc.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
Runes of Malediction and Relic Spirit.   The Runes of Malediction put Demons in the trash into play when destroyed and Relic Spirit puts relics into play when destroyed.  So if you have high enough damage from a card like Rampage you could destroy the Runes, then when the Relic Spirit is destroyed it would put the Runes back into play, since it's a new target you would destroy the Runes again, that causes the Relic Spirit to come back, and this cycle would continue.   Once MigrantP lists the fireside chat for Infernal Relics it will be cleared up on how that loop is broken.

posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

The check for H occurs as the card is played and the one shots can't resolve until it plays the next card. There is no chance for the one shots to fully resolve until there are no more cards left to play.

Ok I can understand that.

But on thinking about it now you hit another problem. If the check occurs after the One Shot enters play but before you perform any action written on the card itself then every card that is played will play every card that comes after it (because none of them use their innate "play a card" text before the manifestation check plays a card).

The last card played from Infinitor's deck (Card Z) it will do its thing and then try to play a card from Infinitor's deck, but because they are all in play it  will have nothing to play, not even from his trash. It will resolve and then enter the trash.

Card Y will then resolve. It will have a card to play, Card Z, once that is played there will be nothing to play so cards Z & Y will enter the trash.

Card X will then resolve. It will have a card to play, Card Z, which will itself have a card to play, Card Y. Once that is played there will be nothing to play so cards Z, Y & X will enter the trash.

etc etc.

 

I guess it's not an infinite loop but it will play Card Z 10 times, Y 9 times, X 8 times, etc, more than enough to finish the game one way or another!
